doc: Look profiles: every print-pass parameter of the D4 world pass (look_d4.gdshader: world), the item pass (look_d4_item.gdshader: item) and the cutout part print (parts_flat_below: below this many screen px per part px Rivet's limbs, collar and core print as flat stickers). zoom_blend is the default look (--look=auto): profile `from` up to start_ppm, blending to profile `to` at full_ppm and above. --look=<id> pins one profile; --look=off draws the raw art. core/render/README.md.

overlays.doc: D5 'Inked Grime' (the d5-close lane's look_d5.gdshader + look_d5.params.json `world`): ink-pressure hatch, paper tooth and off-register ink / vermilion re-printed over the D4 world print, under the actors. Live only when both files exist; then `auto` resolves to `base` (d4) with this overlay ramped by amount_ppm, and `d5` to d4 + the overlay at 1. amount_ppm keeps the brief's pure D4 at gameplay zoom (48 px/m: 0); d5-close proposes 0.35 at 48 px/m (their zoom_amount stop 1.5) - an owner call, one number here.

profiles.doc: D1 Riso Refined, approximated on the D4 pass: flat ink fills, no grime, no misregistration, almost no hatching, clean outlines. The riso dot-screen shader itself is not ported (the safe backup lives in the spike as look=fine).
D4 Ink and Hatch (the target look): the F-08 tuning + the f08b charcoal-street retune (crop gates at 32 and 48 px/m, 2026-11-02).

D5 Inked Grime, pushed where it survives (arena zoom, 64 px/m and above): heavier grime and grit, more hatching at a wider pen period, lower ink-edge thresholds, stronger misregistration of the accent plates. Placeholder values until the d5-close lane delivers its params.

tones.doc: The print passes' output inks as palette.json token ids (pass -> shader uniform -> token): palette.json is the one source of paper / wash / ink. A profile row may still set the uniform itself (a Vector3) to override.
